name: Receipt
description: A till receipt that prints one row per fact at its own time, then a ruled total: a price breakdown, what you really pay, a running sum. The finished receipt fits the clip box; 2-6 rows read best on a phone.

title.description: headline at the top, e.g. 这份奖品到手多少 (omit for none)

header.description: small grey line above the title, e.g. RECEIPT · 中奖小票

sub.description: small grey note under the label

tone.description: value colour: theme token (ink, accent, bad, good, gold, muted) or CSS

at.description: Time this row prints: "line:6", "clip:rc+1.2" or seconds from the clip start. Default: rows spread over the first two thirds of the clip

total.description: the ruled bottom line, printed after the rows

tone.description: value colour: theme token or CSS

at.description: Time the total prints: "line:9" or seconds from the clip start. Default: after the last row
